June 18, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Banque Pictet & Cie Sa decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 15.08% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Banque Pictet & Cie Sa sold 123,552 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 695,566 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $116.70M, down from 819,118 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Banque Pictet & Cie Sa who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $928.72B market cap company. The stock increased 0.06% or $0.1098 during the last trading session, reaching $188.9498. About 6.94M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
